title: fetch_all with per-job timeouts
prompt: Implement fetch_all per the hardened spec: TaskGroup, per-job asyncio.timeout(0.05), timeout converted to the sentinel string, real errors still raised.

tests.name: timeouts convert, successes pass through
tests.code:
async def quick():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.005)
    return 'q'
async def slow():
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
    return 'never'

loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
out = loop.run_until_complete(fetch_all([quick, slow, quick]))
loop.close()
assert out[0] == (0, 'q') and out[2] == (2, 'q'), f'out: {out}'
assert out[1] == (1, 'timeout:0.05'), f'out: {out}'
print('ok')
tests.hint: Wrap each job's await in asyncio.timeout(0.05); catch ONLY TimeoutError.

tests.name: real errors still raise
tests.code:
async def bad():
    raise ValueError('real')

loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
try:
    loop.run_until_complete(fetch_all([bad]))
except* ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('real errors must propagate')
finally:
    loop.close()
print('ok')
tests.hint: except BaseException would mask this — catch TimeoutError only.
